blocks.text: A layout wraps pages that belong under it. The root layout includes the html and body elements for the app.

Use a Next.js App Router project. Save files at the paths shown. For these static examples, use output: "export" in next.config.ts and npm run build. They need Next.js tools and do not run in this playground.

blocks.title: Share a root layout

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: The root layout supplies the document's html and body tags.
`children` is placed between the shared header and footer so the current page stays visible.

blocks.text: The header and footer surround each page placed inside this root layout.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Render children or the selected page will not appear. The root layout needs html and body.

blocks.text: Add a short navigation area to the layout.
